title: Titanic Survival Analysis
description: End-to-end EDA and feature engineering on the classic Titanic dataset, from missing-value handling to a baseline survival model.
businessProblem: Predict which passengers survived the Titanic disaster using demographic and ticketing data, and understand what factors most influenced survival.
workflow: Load and inspect the raw dataset
Handle missing values in Age, Cabin, and Embarked
Train and evaluate a baseline classifier
results: A baseline logistic regression achieved ~81% accuracy; sex and passenger class were the strongest predictors of survival.
lessonsLearned: Title extraction from passenger names was a stronger signal than raw Age after imputation.
